msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia insphyria-27.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of a pair of large blue and black faceted star-shaped acrylic statement earrings from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph.
